description: This file defines a 'Condition Agent' node class for a flow-based AI system, including methods for initialization and condition evaluation, with extensive configuration options and external dependencies.

classes.name: ConditionAgent_SeqAgents
classes.description: A node class implementing a conditional agent for sequential flow control, capable of evaluating conditions via UI or code, and integrating with language models and conversation history.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the condition agent node with configuration, including prompts, models, and validation of input variables.

methods.name: runCondition
methods.description: Executes the condition logic, either via structured output, code, or UI-based conditions, and returns the output route.
